page.title: Inventory Count Management
page.description: Manage physical and cycle counts with a real bin-balance snapshot, tasks, and controlled variance approval.
page.empty: No count document has been created yet.

workflow.snapshotText: When released, expected quantity is frozen by bin, item, configuration, lot, serial and stock status.
workflow.blindText: The operator counts without seeing book quantity; an independent second count can be required.
workflow.varianceText: A variance never edits balance directly. It is posted as an immutable stock movement only after review and approval.

form.title: New Count Plan
form.description: Define scope and controls first. Tasks are created only after the balance preview is approved.
form.wholeWarehouseHint: If no location is selected, all countable warehouse locations are included.
form.selectedLocationHint: {{count}} locations/areas selected. Child bins follow the descendant option.
form.includeEmptyLocations: Create zero-confirmation tasks for empty bins

validation.partialScope: Select at least one location or zone for a partial count.
validation.attempts: Count attempts must be between 1 and 10.
validation.tolerance: Tolerances cannot be negative and percentage cannot exceed 100.
validation.dateRange: Planned end cannot precede planned start.

messages.draftCreated: Count draft created. Preview the scope before release.
messages.saveFailed: Count draft could not be saved.
messages.previewFailed: Count scope could not be previewed.
messages.releaseFailed: Count tasks could not be created.
messages.released: {{taskCount}} location tasks and {{lineCount}} count lines created.
messages.deleteFailed: Count draft could not be deleted.
messages.locationLoadFailed: Location details could not be loaded.

preview.title: {{documentNo}} scope preview
preview.description: Approval freezes the current book balance snapshot and creates location tasks.
preview.ready: Scope is valid. Release also prevents a second active count on the same location.

delete.title: Delete count draft
delete.description: Delete draft {{documentNo}}? Released counts cannot be deleted.
